request: Build a sudoku game with solver in a single HTML file. A 9x9 grid with a backtracking generator that carves three difficulty levels (easy medium hard) while guaranteeing a unique solution, arrow-key navigation between cells, live conflict highlighting, a hint button that fills one empty cell from the solution, a check button that reports conflicts, a solve button that solves the puzzle, a running timer, and best-time persistence per difficulty in localStorage.

intent.goal: sudoku game with solver in a single HTML file.

planFiles.summary: Sudoku game HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file

libraryContext: sudoku with backtracking generator and solver, unique-solution carving, conflict validation, hints, timer, localStorage best times
